description:
Voyager is an innovative defense, national security and space technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space. 

 Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies  

 The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.  

 You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality. 

 If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person,  forge the future with Voyager.  

  

 Voyager Technologies is seeking a  Software Engineer to join a multidisciplinary team of machine learning engineers, software developers, and algorithm developers developing software for geospatial analytics, with an emphasis on exploitation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery.

 The Software Engineer for Voyager Technologies is responsible for designing and developing software systems that process, manage, and visualize large-scale geospatial datasets to support critical capabilities for U.S. government and other customers.



 In this role, the essential functions are:   

 
 Design, implement, and own software systems for processing, managing, and distributing geospatial data, with an emphasis on SAR imagery

 Build scalable data pipelines and backend services supporting geospatial data workflows

 Develop tools and services for geospatial visualization, analysis, and data distribution

 Design and implement database architectures, schemas, and data models supporting geospatial datasets

 Contribute to system architecture decisions, including service design, data pipelines, and software infrastructure

 Integrate geospatial services and APIs into operational software systems

 Collaborate with algorithm developers and data scientists to translate research capabilities into production software

 Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, performance optimization, and software integration

 Contribute to documentation, configuration management, and software delivery processes

 
 The position is part of the Software Engineering department based in El Segundo, CA.   This role is  onsite based in El Segundo, CA.  

  

 If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now,  Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.  

 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI security clearance as a condition of continued employment

 BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field with 5+ years of professional software development experience
OR
MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field with 3+ years of professional software development experience

 Academic background or foundational training in physics, enabling effective bridging of the gap between software engineering and the physical realities of advanced sensing technologies

 Strong programming skills in Python

 Experience developing software in Linux environments

 Experience with modern software development practices including version control, debugging tools, and collaborative development workflows

 Demonstrated track record of independently ideating, proposing, prototyping, and implementing, and fully integrating software solutions that directly improve internal efficiencies, result in new capabilities, and/or otherwise directly impact the bottom line

 
  

 Preferred Qualifications: 

 
 Active Top Secret/SCI clearance 

 Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field

 Experience developing software for geospatial data processing, remote sensing systems, or large-scale geospatial datasets

 Experience designing and implementing database architectures, schemas, and data models, particularly for geospatial or large-scale datasets (e.g., PostGIS or similar technologies)

 Experience designing scalable software architectures, including distributed systems, service-based systems, or large data processing pipelines

 Experience building and maintaining geospatial services and APIs, including standards such as WMS/WFS or other network-based data services

 Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes

 Experience deploying applications in cloud environments such as AWS

 Familiarity with geospatial analysis and visualization tools such as QGIS

 Experience developing workflow orchestration or data processing pipelines using tools such as Apache Airflow

 Experience developing or integrating agentic AI frameworks to automate geospatial workflows, autonomous analysis, or complex data processing pipelines

 Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable secure, standardized connections between AI models and internal geospatial databases, APIs, or operational toolsets

 
  

 The good faith base salary range   for this role is $150,000.00 to $200,000.00 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

 Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.  

 
 Unlimited Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance

 
 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees

 Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness and more! No long term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll

 
 
 401(k) retirement plan with a company match of up to 4% to help you build long-term financial security

 
 
 Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being

 
 
 Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources

 The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission driven environment

 
 Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.  

 Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran 

 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120-130) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) (15 CFR Parts 730-774), applicants for this position must be a U.S. Person: a US Citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). Applicants must be eligible to obtain any required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or the U.S. Department of Commerce. 

 The statements contained in this job description are intended to describe the general content and requirements for performance of this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities, and requirements. This job description is not an employment agreement or contract. Management has the exclusive right to alter the scope of work within the framework of this job description at any time without prior notice.
